name: turn-flow-legacy-projection-closeout
title: Retire live turn-flow legacy back-projection
description: Stop mutating canonical assistant turnFlow back into legacy chat message fields across the live frontend chat runtime.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 full-repo audit confirmed that the frontend chat runtime still called `reconcileTurnFlowWithLegacy()` and `applyLegacyFieldsFromTurnFlow()` through live SSE, lifecycle, and finalize paths, repopulating canonical `turnFlow` into legacy `thinkingContent`, `optimizingTools`, `ragSources`, and `toolCalls`. 2026-04-21 closeout completed: live turn-flow writers now mutate only canonical `turnFlow`, chat rendering reads canonical turn-flow through selector helpers, and legacy fields remain bounded persisted-history fallback input instead of live writable truth. 2026-04-21 audit follow-up closed the remaining live SSE seam where `tool_start` / `tool_call` / native-search progress still dual-wrote `msg.toolCalls`, and moved orphaned running-tool finalization onto canonical turn-flow evidence when canonical flow is present; live stream state is now canonical-first with bounded legacy fallback only when `turnFlow` is absent. Display normalization also stops synthesizing `tool_selection` timeline stages from legacy `optimizingTools` when canonical `turnFlow` already exists. Verified with `pnpm --dir frontend exec vue-tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --pretty false -p apps/web-antd/tsconfig.json` and `pnpm --dir frontend exec vitest run apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/__tests__/use-ai-chat.test.ts apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/__tests__/ChatMessageItem.test.ts apps/web-antd/src/features/ai-monitoring/__tests__/turn-flow-cross-surface.test.ts apps/web-antd/src/features/ai-monitoring/__tests__/MonitoringConversationMessagesCard.turn-flow.test.ts`.
